title: Gold/USD MLOps pipeline, isometric 3D
purpose: Not generated by generate.py. Exported from Arcentry, which built it from the project's own Terraform plan, so the ground truth comes from infrastructure code rather than from a drawing. Tests the extraction against a rendering style nothing else in this set covers: isometric projection, vendor-specific 3D models instead of flat AWS icons, labels rotated off the horizontal, and connection lines that bend several times and cross each other. No violations are visible in this diagram — it states no configuration — so the review is expected to report nothing, and this case measures reading rather than judging.
